notes: Source: archive.org scan of Sega's 'SEGA CD Model 1 Manual' (US), page 2 'INTRODUCTION' and page 3 'UNPACKING YOUR SEGA-CD' (front, back and left-side views). The OCR text layer is unusable, so the quotes are our transcription from the page images.
role addon, host_console sega-mega-drive (the Genesis model 1 object; the manual's page 3 also instructs sliding 'the Genesis sideways ... into place on top of the SEGA CD').
media: the front view labels the 'Disc Tray for 8cm or 12cm Discs': disc_tray.

ports: the views label the 'SEGA-CD/Genesis Connector Terminal' (filed as expansion), the 'AC Adapter Jack' (power_in), and two audio jacks with no contract kind ('Audio Line Out Jacks', 'Mixing Jack'), noted not filed.
controls uncovered: the parts views label no buttons (only 'Indicator LEDs').
Envelope and mass: no maker or museum figure found; Sega's archive returns 403.
external_ids: Wikidata Q1047516 confirmed through the Wikidata API; igdb_platform 'segacd' is Wikidata's P5795 on that item.
